metadata.title: Marvell’s stock surges on news of Google chip deal — and Broadcom’s falls - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Marvell’s stock surges on news of Google chip deal — and Broadcom’s falls
Google will also get the option to purchase about $12 billion worth of Marvell’s stock
Marvell Technology shares were rising more than 10% in premarket action on Wednesday after the company announced a new agreement with Alphabet related to custom artificial-intelligence chips.
The company disclosed Wednesday that it struck a commercial agreement related to Google’s GOOG GOOGL tensor processing units. “The expanded partnership spans a comprehensive range of custom silicon programs” related to TPUs, including accelerators and storage controllers.
